response.text: I'll start by checking the main audit areas with set-based queries.

arguments.sql: SELECT j."JRNL_NO", SUM(j."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(j."DR_AMT")-SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" j GROUP BY j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(j."DR_AMT")-SUM(j."CR_AMT"))>0.005 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p."INV_ID", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid, i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" GROUP BY p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING i."INV_AMT" IS NULL OR SUM(p."PAY_AMT")>i."INV_AMT" OR (i."STAT_CD"='O' AND SUM(p."PAY_AMT")>=i."INV_AMT") ORDER BY 1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (SELECT a."INV_ID" FROM "APINVH" a JOIN "APINVH" b ON REPLACE(LTRIM(UPPER(TRIM(a."INV_NO")),'0'),'-','')=REPLACE(LTRIM(UPPER(TRIM(b."INV_NO")),'0'),'-','') AND UPPER(TRIM(a."VEND_CD"))=UPPER(TRIM(b."VEND_CD")) AND a."INV_ID"<>b."INV_ID") ORDER BY 1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."PRD_ID" IS NULL OR h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" ORDER BY 1
SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."POST_FLG", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT j."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_CD" AS coa_cd, c."ACTV_FLG" FROM "GLJRNL" j LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON UPPER(TRIM(c."ACCT_CD"))=UPPER(TRIM(j."ACCT_CD")) WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y' ORDER BY 1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APVEND" v ON UPPER(TRIM(v."VEND_CD"))=UPPER(TRIM(i."VEND_CD")) WHERE v."VEND_CD" IS NULL OR v."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y' ORDER BY 1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."DR_AMT", j."CR_AMT", h."SRC_REF", h."POST_FLG" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO") j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR ABS(COALESCE(j.cr,0)-i."INV_AMT")>0.005 ORDER BY 1
